description.en: The ID of the database. Call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) API to obtain this ID.
The pagination offset. The default value is 0.

description.zh: 搜索关键词，用于模糊匹配知识内容
description.en: The keyword for a fuzzy search on knowledge content.

description.zh: 知识展示类型筛选，可选值如 TABLE、COLUMN、SQL、SEG 等，为空表示全部
description.en: The type of knowledge to return. Valid values: `TABLE`, `COLUMN`, `SQL`, and `SEG`. If this parameter is omitted, all types are returned.
The number of entries to return per page. The default value is 20.

title.zh: 分页查询某张表相关的资产知识列表

descriptions.zh: 分页查询某张表相关的资产知识列表，支持按知识类型、关键词等条件筛选，返回 KnowledgeBaseVO 分页结果
descriptions.en: Queries a paginated list of asset knowledge related to a specific table. You can filter the results by criteria such as knowledge type and keyword. The API returns a paginated list of `KnowledgeBaseVO` objects.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise search-table-asset-knowledge --db-id 1000 --table-name order_info --search-key '订单' --show-type TABLE --size 20 --offset 0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise SearchTableAssetKnowledge --region cn-hangzhou --TableName order_info --Size 20 --SearchKey '订单' --DbId 1000 --ShowType TABLE --Offset 0
